description:
Multi-hop retrieval bench for Cycle H.2 LazyGraphRAG vs LanceDB-only.  Queries are crafted from AMOR's own repository to exercise community-aware retrieval: each one references 2+ entities that should belong to the same community in the graph (so the LazyGraphRAG pre-filter narrows the candidate set meaningfully) while the LanceDB-only path receives only a dense vector match.

Ground-truth labels (`relevant_source_ids`) are file paths inside the repo whose chunks should appear in the top-K result list.  Operator can extend this seed (currently ~20 queries) toward the v20 gate's 100-query target as the corpus stabilises.

v20 gate condition #5: nDCG@10 uplift LazyGraphRAG vs LanceDB-only ≥ 15%.

queries.query: How does ApprovalPolicy gate ToolRegistry dispatch calls?
Which compose changes promoted docker-socket-proxy from opt-in to default?
Where does the engine fire the BitNet shadow planner call and how is it timed out?
How does the LazyGraphRAG pre-filter narrow LanceDB candidate source_ids?
How is the verifier_rewards annotation step wired into the weekly ORPO cron?
What are the six v20.0.0 launch gate conditions and their thresholds?
Where does the engine invoke the mutation runner and emit results?
How does HumanEval+ generate predictions against the local llm-swap endpoint?
How does the SWE-bench runner switch between simplified mode and the full harness?
How does the ThinkingEngine apply per-phase wall-clock timeouts and fall back?
How does the engine kick off the Phi-4 critic asynchronously and reconcile freshness?
How does AMOR hot-swap LoRA adapters via the llama-swap config without restart?
Where does an agent's default memory get persisted and why was the tempfile fallback removed?
How does the SSE pipeline handle a replica swap without losing the in-progress stream?
What were the six v18 launch acceptance conditions and which failed first?
What does the code_pipeline_parallel flag control and what's the rollback recipe?
How does the ApprovalPrompt React/SolidJS card resolve a pending tool dispatch?
How does the domain template inject must-have features into the coder prompt?
How does the SKILL.md frontmatter loader parse + validate skill definitions?
How does the cron export Postgres preference pairs to per-role JSONL files?

operator_notes: Each query lists `relevant_source_ids` as path-strings.  The bench tool computes nDCG@10 using these as the gold ranking; the LanceDB embedder's source-id metadata must match.
Communities are diagnostic — the bench tool can use them to verify the LazyGraphRAG entity-graph clustering picks up the same groupings.
Expand to 100 queries by adding each round of new cross-module work (Cycle I+ should add Titans / LFM2 / KAT queries; Cycle J adds Saten / SB / JEPA queries).
